title: Can Visa gift cards be used internationally?
summary: Do Visa gift cards work internationally? Yes, if the card is globally enabled. Learn when cards can work across regions and how to check your card.
body_markdown:
**Do Visa gift cards work internationally? Yes. Visa gift cards can be used in multiple countries, but only if the card is enabled for global use. Standard US-purchased Visa gift cards are typically restricted to domestic transactions.**


Visa gift cards offer almost as much flexibility as cash, but with much of the same convenience as a debit card. But you might be wondering whether they can be used in other countries.


The short answer is yes, but it depends on the card. You’ll need to check either your physical card or the cardholder agreement to know for sure. If your Visa gift card can be used internationally, the back of the card will say something like, “valid worldwide where Visa is accepted.”


But even with global-enabled Visa gift cards, there are a few limitations you should consider.


Here’s what you need to know about using Visa gift cards abroad and sending them to recipients in other parts of the world.

## **Using Visa gift cards internationally**


Virtual Visa gift cards enabled for global use can be used in over 200 different countries and regions. They work just like regular credit/debit cards at[any merchant that accepts prepaid Visa cards](https://www.tremendous.com/blog/use-prepaid-visa-gift-cards/) . If you want to use a virtual Visa gift card in a physical store, you’ll need to load it onto a digital wallet like Apple Pay or Google Pay.


When you use a[gift card for purchases in a foreign country](https://www.tremendous.com/blog/what-gift-cards-can-be-used-internationally/) , the currency conversion happens automatically. This means you don’t need to worry about tracking down the exchange rate or finding a local currency exchange.


Visa prepaid gift cards also work for many types of purchases online, like a regular debit card. (Just keep in mind not all merchants accept prepaid cards.)


It's important to note that not all Visa cards are reloadable. Once the balance is spent, these cards can’t be topped up. However, this still makes them an excellent choice for sending a specific amount as a gift.


### Virtual vs. physical Visa gift cards for international use


Virtual Visa gift cards work for online purchases in any supported country, and without the shipping delays of physical cards. To use one in a store abroad, add it to Apple Pay or Google Pay where merchants accept them. Physical Visa gift cards work at chip-and-PIN terminals that accept Visa, but they may trigger fraud blocks if the issuer hasn't been notified of international use.


## How to check if your Visa gift card works internationally


Not sure whether a card you already have works abroad? Here's how to find out:


1.


Check the back of the card. If it says “Valid only in the United States,” it will be declined in other countries.


2.


Review the cardholder agreement. It came with the card or is posted on the issuer’s website, and it spells out the international acceptance terms.


3.


Look for “valid worldwide where Visa is accepted” or similar language. That confirms the card is enabled for global use.


4.


Call the issuer if you’re still unsure. Use the number on the back of the card.


## Where can Visa gift cards be used?


Visa gift cards enabled for global use can be accepted in multiple countries and regions (at merchants that allow prepaid cards). For example, the[digital Tremendous Visa® Rewards Card](https://app.notion.com/p/tremendous/Frequently-Asked-Questions-8fda89731faa47f7825caaa9862e2efa?source=copy_link) can be used in[200+ regions](https://www.tremendous.com/catalog/?categories=Prepaid+cards) .


## Which countries don’t accept Visa gift cards?


The following countries do not accept Visa cards due to[OFAC sanctions](https://ofac.treasury.gov/sanctions-programs-and-country-information) , Visa network restrictions, or local regulatory requirements. For recipients in these countries, choose an alternate payout method.

Balkans Iran Somalia

## **Guidelines and considerations for employers issuing Visa gift cards internationally**


Sending international customers, prospects, employees, or research participants a Visa prepaid gift card allows them a lot more flexibility in how they can use their reward or incentive.


International recipients can use Visa gift cards online at many of the same retailers that accept regular Visa cards. As a result, Visa gift cards are a much more attractive option than a gift card to a specific retailer, which significantly limits how recipients can spend their reward.


While[Visa gift cards are a great option](https://www.tremendous.com/blog/gift-card-distribution/) for recipients in and outside of the U.S., there are some limitations and restrictions to consider.


### Regional restrictions


Some Visa gift cards work only in the country where they're purchased. Check the cardholder agreement before sending rewards internationally.


### Transaction fees


For international purchases, currency exchange rates vary and foreign transaction fees may apply. You can check the current exchange rate on[Visa’s exchange rate calculator](https://usa.visa.com/support/consumer/travel-support/exchange-rate-calculator.html) .


Platforms like[Tremendous](https://www.tremendous.com/) make it easier for organizations to send rewards to recipients worldwide, with payout options that include internationally enabled prepaid cards, bank transfers, PayPal, and more. For teams managing incentive programs, letting recipients choose a payout method that works locally for them is the most flexible option.
